verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents async job handling with webhooks for job completion and failure, and lists a batch-processing example. That covers the basic mechanics of pushing many documents through, and the Kubernetes/Helm self-hosting option suggests capacity could be scaled in your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: documented rate limits or quotas, published throughput or latency figures, any evidence of million-page-scale runs, a dedicated bulk/batch API (only an example is cited), and independent corroboration of predictable performance at volume.
